augmentation.interpretation: The five-dimensional fibre augmentation is the irreducible icosahedral quadrupole module, the traceless part of the six-axis permutation representation.

boundary: The P1(F5)/icosahedral-axis identification and 280-dimensional augmentation bundle are exact. The numerical equality 56*5=40*7 does not by itself define a canonical 56-by-40 W33 incidence geometry.

colored_comparison.lesson: The five colorings and five-dimensional Singer fibre are distinct A5 modules despite the shared numeral five.

six_fibre.icosahedral_model: six fivefold rotation axes, equivalently six antipodal vertex pairs
